And this has 6 more sailors. Making a comparison of this ship to RHG is fair.

Considering the enemy will suffer badly from crew loss, it is fair to imagine that he will have trouble decing wether to surg or repair. Speed in combat is a bit lower, not dramatic lower, as i have tested. Those that sail ATS will know it. This ship handicap is dura. But well used, its very powerfull. I would never trade it for a RHG and i WTB
